items.title: Judge Awards $250,000 to Musician Who Fled Trump-Led Kennedy Center Gig
items.author: Julia Jacobs
items.content: <article>The center had sued Chuck Redd when he canceled a free concert last year, citing the addition of the Trump name to the venue. But a judge dismissed the case.</article>

items.title: When to Expect Results in Wisconsin, Minnesota, South Carolina and Beyond
items.author: Taylor Robinson
items.content: <article>Six states are holding elections on Tuesday. The unofficial results will be known late Tuesday or early Wednesday.</article>

items.title: Democrats Accuse Trump Administration of Stonewalling Major Transit Projects
items.author: Emily Badger
items.content: <article>Congressional Democrats express concern that the delays involve “political considerations.”</article>

items.title: Angie Craig Has Cash Edge Over Peggy Flanagan in Minnesota’s Democratic Senate Primary
items.author: Theodore Schleifer
items.content: <article>Representative Angie Craig has benefited from nearly $10 million in spending from groups whose donors remain hidden, giving her an advantage in her Senate primary against Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan.</article>

items.title: This is how President Trump came to back Darline Graham.
items.author: Emily Davies
items.content: <article>President Trump’s support for Darline Graham, the sister of the late senator Lindsey Graham but a political unknown, is a gamble as Republicans and Democrats battle for control of the House and Senate.</article>

items.title: Ex-Marine Robert Gilman Is Freed by Russia After 4 Years in Prison
items.author: Ephrat Livni
items.content: <article>The Kremlin released Robert Gilman, whose family and an advocacy group had said he was in dire physical condition, on “a humanitarian basis,” President Trump said.</article>

items.title: What to Watch in Tuesday’s Primary Elections in Wisconsin, Minnesota and South Carolina
items.author: Patricia Mazzei
items.content: <article>The left and the middle continue to battle in Democratic primaries for governor in Wisconsin and Senate in Minnesota. In South Carolina, all eyes are on Darline Graham.</article>

items.title: Trump Picks Project 2025 Co-Author for Role That Would Oversee Any Reflecting Pool Review
items.author: Isabella Kwai
items.content: <article>Dennis Kirk, a former adviser to Tulsi Gabbard, is President Trump’s nominee for inspector general for the Interior Department.</article>

items.title: U.S. Says It Revoked More Than 175,000 Visas Under Trump
items.author: Isabella Kwai
items.content: <article>Most visas were rescinded over criminal accusations, the State Department said, while some were revoked from people who had celebrated the assassination of Charlie Kirk.</article>

items.title: Democrats Plan New Push to Defeat Max Miller in Ohio After Abuse Accusations
items.author: Emily Davies
items.content: <article>The party’s congressional campaign arm added Mr. Miller’s opponent, Brian Poindexter, to its highly competitive “Red to Blue” list.</article>

items.title: Trump Wants to Move On From the Middle East. It’s Not Letting Him.
items.author: Anton Troianovski
items.content: <article>President Trump is eager to declare success in Iran and Gaza, but he is struggling to impose his will in either conflict.</article>

items.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
items.author: Zolan Kanno-Youngs
items.content: <article>Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”</article>

items.title: Homeland Security Intensifies Pursuit of Noncitizens on Voter Rolls
items.author: Madeleine Ngo, Nick Corasaniti and Hamed Aleaziz
items.content: <article>Immigrants who said they inadvertently registered to vote while obtaining or renewing driver’s licenses are increasingly facing deportation under the Trump administration.</article>

items.title: Wisconsin’s Roller Coaster of a Democratic Primary Race for Governor Crashes to an End
items.author: Jess Bidgood
items.content: <article>Democrats appear likely to nominate a democratic socialist for governor. How did they get here?</article>

items.title: How a Counterintelligence Inquiry Into Trump’s Russia Ties Was Derailed
items.author: Michael S. Schmidt
items.content: <article>Documents released by the White House shed new light on the demise of an often-overlooked 2017 F.B.I. investigation.</article>
